source: Production and portable images built from a clean git archive of the recorded commit. Both OCI revision labels matched.

host.engine: rootless Podman 6.1.4, local Docker-compatible Unix socket

configuration.project: isolated disposable project with fresh named volumes
configuration.qualification_override: Desktop port 7134 was occupied. Changed only the host port to 17142 and the corresponding Vessel SERVER__PORT. The container still listened on 8000.
configuration.model_execution: CPU, 0 GPU layers, f16 K/V caches, single fixed GGUF

bridge.prompt: What is 12 plus 7? Reply with just the number.

restart.procedure: After the synthetic Run settled, Compose down retired every project container and its network. Compose up --detach --no-build --wait --wait-timeout 180 recreated them on the retained project volumes.

scope: Linux provider and browser only. macOS and Windows Docker Desktop networking, hardware, native-to-container CLI operation, host reboot, and recovery of interrupted work require separate evidence.
